questions.question: For an offset back/right parking maneuver, what should you do?

options.text: Go straight forward, then back to the right.
Go straight forward, then back to the left.
Go forward to the right, then back in a straight line.
Go forward to the left, then back in a straight line.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go straight forward, then back to the right.
questions.explanation: For an offset back/right parking maneuver, go straight forward first. Then back up to the right. Your vehicle must be completely within the parking space boundaries.

questions.question: What counts as a look during a basic vehicle control skills test?

options.text: Getting out of the driver's seat and walking to the back of the vehicle to check where it is
Using side mirrors to check where the vehicle is
Looking out the driver's side window to check where the vehicle is
Glancing over your shoulder to check blind spots

questions.correctAnswerText: Getting out of the driver's seat and walking to the back of the vehicle to check where it is
questions.explanation: A look means you open your door, leave your seat, and walk to the back of the vehicle to check its position. For straight line backing, you can do one look only. For other exercises, you can do two looks only.

questions.question: When entering traffic on an expressway during the skills test, what should you do?

options.text: Check for traffic.
Do not use turn signals.
Quickly enter a lane of traffic.
Cut off other drivers if you need to.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic.
questions.explanation: During the on-road driving skills test, you may enter an expressway. Before you do, you must check traffic, use turn signals, and merge smoothly into the correct lane.

questions.question: When driving through a curve during the skills test, what should you do?

options.text: Leave your lane if needed to complete the curve.
Slow down after you enter the curve.
Do not look for other vehicles while turning.
Slow down before you enter the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before you enter the curve.
questions.explanation: When you see a curve coming, slow down enough before you enter it so you do not need to brake or shift gears in the curve. Stay in your lane and keep checking for traffic all around you.

questions.question: What is an active railroad crossing?

options.text: A crossing that has traffic control devices installed.
A crossing with no traffic control devices installed.
A crossing where at least 10 vehicles cross the tracks every hour.
A crossing you should avoid.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossing that has traffic control devices installed.
questions.explanation: Active railroad crossings have traffic control devices installed. These can be flashing red lights, bells, or gates. You must always follow the directions of these devices.

questions.question: During the stop/start maneuver on the skills test, what should you do?

options.text: Cut off other vehicles to get onto the shoulder.
Do not use turn signals.
Brake hard to stop as fast as possible.
Slow down smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down smoothly.
questions.explanation: During the on-road driving skills test, you will pull over to the side of the road as if checking your vehicle. As you do this, check traffic, use your turn signal, slow down smoothly with gentle braking and gear changes, and come to a full stop without coasting.

questions.question: What does the overhead inside rearview mirror do?

options.text: Shows what is happening inside the bus.
Shows what is happening outside the bus.
Watches traffic.
Opens and closes the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shows what is happening inside the bus.
questions.explanation: In a school bus, the overhead inside rearview mirror lets the driver watch passengers inside the bus.

questions.question: When alley docking, where should your vehicle be parked?

options.text: With the front bumper on the front boundary line.
With the rear wheels past the rear boundary line.
Straight within the parking space boundaries.
At an angle within the parking space boundaries.

questions.correctAnswerText: Straight within the parking space boundaries.
questions.explanation: For alley docking, first drive past the alley and stop parallel to the outer boundary. Then back your vehicle straight into the alley parking space. Your vehicle must be straight and completely within the parking space boundaries.

questions.question: What should you see with properly adjusted outside convex mirrors?

options.text: The entire side of the bus up to the mirror mounts.
The front of the bus.
The rear door of the bus.
The top of the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: The entire side of the bus up to the mirror mounts.
questions.explanation: Outside convex mirrors should be adjusted to show at least one traffic lane on each side of the bus, the entire side of the bus up to the mirror mounts, and where the front of each rear tire touches the ground.

questions.question: Where are outside convex mirrors located on a bus?

options.text: Below the outside flat mirrors.
Above the outside flat mirrors.
Next to the door.
On top of the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Below the outside flat mirrors.
questions.explanation: Outside convex mirrors are located below the outside flat mirrors on a school bus. They give a wide view of traffic, clearance, and students around the bus.

questions.question: During the basic control skills test, you lose points by:

options.text: Crossing over an exercise boundary.
Pulling up one time.
Exiting the vehicle one time to check your positioning.
Setting the parking brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Crossing over an exercise boundary.
questions.explanation: The examiner counts each time your vehicle touches or crosses a boundary line. Each touch or crossing is an error that lowers your score.

questions.question: Where is the overhead inside rearview mirror located in a school bus?

options.text: Above the windshield on the driver's side
Above the door on the passenger side
Above the emergency door in the rear
Under the driver's seat

questions.correctAnswerText: Above the windshield on the driver's side
questions.explanation: The overhead inside rearview mirror is mounted above the windshield on the driver's side. It helps the driver watch students inside the bus.

questions.question: After students get off the bus at school, the driver should:

options.text: Assume students took all their things.
Assume students cleared the doorway right away.
Walk through the bus to check for students who are sleeping or hiding.
Turn off the dispatch radio.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk through the bus to check for students who are sleeping or hiding.
questions.explanation: After students exit, walk through the bus to look for any students who may be sleeping or hiding. Also look for items students left behind.

questions.question: When checking tire condition during the vehicle inspection, you should check for:

options.text: More wear on the insides of the tires.
More wear on the outsides of the tires.
More wear in the middle of the tires.
Even wear across the tires.

questions.correctAnswerText: Even wear across the tires.
questions.explanation: During the vehicle inspection, check that tire treads are worn evenly across the tire.

questions.question: In most emergencies, student safety is best maintained by:

options.text: Keeping students on the bus.
Letting some students leave while others stay.
Letting all students leave the bus.
Creating panic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keeping students on the bus.
questions.explanation: In most emergencies, students are safest when they stay on the bus where you can control and protect them.

questions.question: When driving on the expressway during the skills test, you should:

options.text: Switch lanes frequently.
Check your mirrors often to see traffic.
Drive on the left side of your lane.
Drive faster than the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors often to see traffic.
questions.explanation: On the expressway, stay in your lane, keep good distance between vehicles, and drive at the correct speed. Always check your mirrors in all directions.

questions.question: During the on-road driving skills test, when using gears you should not:

options.text: Grind or clash gears.
Select a gear that makes the engine work too hard or too light.
Shift while going through an intersection.
Shift while turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift while turning.
questions.explanation: During the on-road driving skills test, pick the right gear to avoid grinding gears. Do not shift while turning or going through intersections.

questions.question: During the pre-trip inspection test, you will:

options.text: Explain what you are checking and why.
Watch someone else check the vehicle.
Watch a film about vehicle inspection.
Change all the tires.

questions.correctAnswerText: Explain what you are checking and why.
questions.explanation: During the vehicle inspection test, you must do a complete inspection and explain each item you check and why it is important.

questions.question: A school bus has a blind spot that extends at least ____ behind it.

options.text: 10 feet
50 feet
100 feet
1,000 feet

questions.correctAnswerText: 50 feet
questions.explanation: A school bus has blind spots below and in front of the side mirrors, and behind the rear bumper. The rear blind spot typically extends 50 to 150 feet behind the bus, but can extend up to 400 feet depending on the bus size.

questions.question: When students exit the bus, they should:

options.text: Stay seated until told to exit.
Stand up and head to the door while the bus is moving.
Exit and stand next to the bus until it leaves.
Jump down from the top step.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay seated until told to exit.
questions.explanation: Students should stay in their seats until the driver tells them to leave. After exiting, they should walk at least 10 feet away from the bus to a place where the driver can see them.
